classification: Post-freeze methodological and source-completeness addendum, no original values changed

bridgePrecision.interpretation: 70% was declared rounded judgment, not exact bridge; show added revenue rather than presenting rounding as immaterial.

scaleCaveat: No dated independent TAM or customer-capex budget reconstruction validates these final-year sales. They are implied scenario scales, not demonstrated addressable demand. Bottom-up customer deployment, replacement cycles, inference economics and alternative-silicon share are required to validate them.
capitalMechanism: Maturity can demand larger working-capital buffers, capacity reservations/prepayments, system/networking mix, support/cloud infrastructure and replacement/obsolescence investment. These mechanisms could reduce sales/capital. The exact3to0.6962path is an algebraic competitive-return constraint, NOT measured proof these mechanisms reach that magnitude. No invented fabs are assumed.

knownCommitments.treatment: Operating inventory and cloud/R&D commitments belong in future operating costs and working-capital/investment timing; do not deduct20.7bn wholesale as debt in addition. Base first-year net reinvestment14.22bn is an undifferentiated sales/capital proxy, not a line-item reconciliation to these commitments or PPE guidance. Validate by detailed dated cash-flow schedule in a future version.
